generator_runtime_only.scope: metadata generation, not final worker/runtime binding

randomization.steps: i=71 down to1; m=i+1; hash UTF8(seed)||00||uint64be(counter), counter starts0 and increments after each digest; x=uint256be(digest); reject x>=floor(2^256/m)*m; j=x%m; swap positions i,j
randomization.hash_rejection_scope: Only deterministic integer range reduction; never native/sample retry.
randomization.schedule_digest_encoding: UTF8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false; no trailing newline
randomization.interpretation: Balanced randomized order does not establish independence of pair log contrasts.

statistics.native_total_ns: retain separately, never substitute for derived total
statistics.unit: 72 role-corrected control/candidate pairs, never144 independent children or phases
statistics.critical_values: retain independently audited original numeric evidence; final worker must bind it
statistics.zero_policy: Preserve canonical nonnegative integer zero; any zero in either role makes that metric undefined_log_contrast_zero_preserved; no epsilon, deletion, replacement or resolution change.
statistics.promotion: All72 pairs complete AND every metric defined (including all auxiliary) AND primary_upper<1 AND no auxiliary_lower>1 AND every predeclared engineering/correctness/resource/recovery/independent-audit gate passed.
statistics.auxiliary_crossing_one: not confirmed regression; never equivalence or proof of no regression
statistics.invalid_or_failed_window: Missing, negative, noncanonical, nonfinite, schema/role/identity/truth/native/deadline failure closes unique attempt; summary=null; no prefix benefit.
forbidden: combining R1/M2 samples or adding their percentage savings

execution_constraints_for_later_freeze.compiler_profile: bare -O3 -DNDEBUG; no -UNDEBUG, diagnostic hook or capture
execution_constraints_for_later_freeze.supervisor: original shared run_job.py and Documents/.../build/vm-coordination/queue.lock; no nested lease or new lock
execution_constraints_for_later_freeze.quiet: Other agents stop scanning/compiling/archiving during timing.
execution_constraints_for_later_freeze.failure: Stop, clean descendants, restore user processes, seal prefix; no extra attempt.
execution_constraints_for_later_freeze.recovery_order: Restore user processes before offline audit.

not_yet_bound_for_execution: actual bare control/candidate binaries, compile profile, compiler/libc++/runtime/driver/adapter/input/wire/trace closure
predeclared common C14 control plus candidate dynamic mechanism hit with same final diagnostic closure
actual complete process/wall/output projection, RSS/allocated peak, both volumes/backing, child and seal margin
explicit acceptable build/maintenance/free/retained/active-memory cost gates before seeing results
actual unique attempt id, argv/output paths, host quiet, original lease and stop/recovery checks
independent root freeze with external pin covering this entire schedule and all preceding bindings
immutability: This is a prepared design, not a worker request. Preserve this version; any prelaunch revision needs a new version and independent review. After freeze no schedule/seed or sample substitutions.
